convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom with 'MACDCandle' (unknown custom indicator) and includes external TradeAlgorithms.mqh library for order management. Logic requires manual Python reimplementation of custom indicator and trade helper functions.

derived_values.name: Col[2] - color buffer values from MACDCandle buffer 4
derived_values.formula: CopyBuffer(handle, 4, SignalBar, 2, Col) → Col[0]=previous color, Col[1]=current color where 0=bearish, 2=bullish

other_exits: Long position closed when MACDCandle color changes to bearish (Col[1]==0)
Short position closed when MACDCandle color changes to bullish (Col[1]==2)
BuyPosClose and SellPosClose input flags can disable signal-based closing

params.description: MM=0.1 is fraction of margin/deposit depending on MMMode enum (LOT, FREE_MARGIN, etc.)

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MMMode enum from TradeAlgorithms.mqh controls lot calculation method

custom_logic_notes: The EA reads buffer index 4 from the custom MACDCandle indicator, which returns color codes (0=bearish, 2=bullish). Long entry requires Col[1]==2 (current bar bullish) AND Col[0]<2 (previous bar not bullish) — a bullish color change. Short entry requires Col[1]==0 (current bar bearish) AND Col[0]>0 (previous bar not bearish) — a bearish color change. Signal reversal closes opposite positions. The mode enum (MODE_HISTOGRAM=0 vs MODE_SIGNAL_LINE=1) changes how MACDCandle renders/signals but is passed through as a parameter. BuyPosOpen/SellPosOpen/BuyPosClose/SellPosClose inputs act as gates to enable/disable specific directions. TradeAlgorithms.mqh provides BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose, GlobalVariableDel_, LoadHistory, and CIsNewBar — all must be reimplemented. Entry is gated by IsNewBar() check OR Recount flag OR SignalBar==0.
python_conversion_notes: Must reimplement MACDCandle custom indicator logic: it wraps a standard MACD (12/26/9) and outputs color codes on buffer 4. MODE_SIGNAL_LINE mode compares MACD vs signal line for coloring; MODE_HISTOGRAM mode compares histogram vs zero. Must also reimplement TradeAlgorithms.mqh functions for position open/close with fixed SL/TP and margin-based lot sizing. The core signal logic is simple: bullish color change → buy, bearish color change → sell, with signal-reversal closing. The SignalBar=1 parameter means signals are evaluated on the last completed bar (shift 1).
